t_1.speaker: Narration
t_1.text: A quiet room. A patient voice across from you: "Whenever you're ready. All of you." For the first time, there's space to put the whole of it into words.

t_2.speaker: Narration
t_2.text: It will take someone who can stay present while the past comes up. Who speaks for the system?

t_strong.speaker: Narration
t_strong.text: The words come slowly, then steadily — one voice making room for the others. Nothing is rushed, nothing is hidden. For once, the system tells its story together.

t_ok.speaker: Narration
t_ok.text: It comes out in pieces, with long pauses — but it comes out. Some of it, said aloud at last, loosens its grip.

t_strain.speaker: Narration
t_strain.text: It's hard, and it stalls, and the room gets very quiet. But even saying a little of it, to someone who listens, is not nothing.

t_done.speaker: Narration
t_done.text: You walk out into the evening lighter than you came in. The story isn't finished — but it's begun to be told.
